test_send_telemetry: test the send_telemetry function to verify it sends HTTP HEAD requests to the telemetry endpoint
test_send_telemetry_multiple: test the send_telemetry function with multiple topics to verify order is preserved
test_send_telemetry_subtopic: test the send_telemetry function with nested subtopic paths like gradio/image/this_one
test_send_telemetry_quoted: test the send_telemetry function with spaces in topic to verify URL encoding
test_send_telemetry_disabled: test the send_telemetry function when HF_HUB_OFFLINE or HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY is enabled
